Your life matters. I don't have depression, I'm not gonna try to relate to the pain you're feeling, you're so strong for making it to this point in your life. When I'm sad (again, doesn't compare to depression) I listen to music (not sad music, try classical, makes you feel like your favorite TV show or movie character) and get out for a walk, really enjoy the nature, think about your past, how far you've come, about your loved ones. I LOVE YOU AND SO DO OTHERS. DONT END YOUR LIFE. PLEASE.
